title: stillingia obtusifolia
intro: Stillingia obtusifolia, commonly known as Queen's Delight, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stillingia obtusifolia include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
